# Aleks CP

> Aleks CP (also Aleks Clapin-Pépin) is a Senior Platform Engineer and SRE with 10+ years building and operating production infrastructure. He co-founded Folk Software, a software studio that builds cloud infrastructure and AI agent systems for small teams, and offers packaged, self-hosted Hermes Agent deployments.

Based in Bangkok, Thailand (UTC+7). Open to fully remote employment or B2B contracts. Works async-first. Languages: English, French (native or bilingual), German (elementary). Contact: me@alekscp.com

Core skills: Kubernetes, Terraform/OpenTofu, AWS, GCP, Linux, Docker, CI/CD, observability, production operations, AI agent infrastructure.

## Services

- [Secure self-hosted Hermes AI agent deployment](https://alekscp.com/services/hermes-agent-deployment/index.md): Ubuntu server setup, Docker Compose runtime, Telegram or Discord integration, private access via Tailscale or reverse proxy, backups, restore notes, and handoff documentation.
